normal: No visible manufacturing defects; the part appears conforming.
defective: At least one visible manufacturing defect or anomaly.

normal: Grey fabric with a soft, smooth texture of long diagonal streaks that blend gently into each other; no spots, marks or areas that differ from the rest.
defective: Grey fabric with a visible anomaly: either a small local spot or mark, or a texture that is grainier, more speckled and noisier across the whole image, with short choppy strokes instead of long smooth diagonal streaks.
reason: Global defects scored low (mean 0.245); they look grainier and more speckled over the whole image than the smooth streaked nominals. The texts now describe this texture difference.
